interpretation_notes: Primary inference uses the five Holm-adjusted exact sign-flip tests at familywise alpha 0.05. Paired-t results are a separately adjusted sensitivity analysis, not an alternative route to significance.
All ten prespecified seeds are paired by identity; no failed or nonfinite outcome is dropped.
Two-sided paired-t inference assumes independent seed pairs and approximately normally distributed paired seed differences.
The exact sign-flip test assumes sign exchangeability (symmetry) of paired differences under the null.
Sign flips enumerate all 1024 configurations and include every statistic equal to the observed magnitude.
The smallest possible two-sided exact p-value with ten nonzero pairs is 2/1024, before Holm adjustment.

confirmation.secondary_metrics: descriptive only; no hypothesis tests or multiplicity-adjusted claims

evidence_scope.adaptive_vs_tuned_fixed: two prespecified direct paired contrasts; preserve every estimate, interval and adjusted p-value
evidence_scope.component_attribution: spectral audio regularization on a common fixed labeled training set; not a classification acquisition ablation
evidence_scope.external_generalization: same previously studied AudioCaps benchmark; not an untouched or new external dataset
evidence_scope.robustness_and_geometry: not measured in this AudioCaps study; smaller-radius classification diagnostics remain a separate campaign

fixed_selection.rule: highest mean final-step development CIDEr-D across three tuning seeds; exact tie: smaller lambda

limits: Job wall time includes the retained training/evaluation attempts recorded by JobContext.
Fresh saved-result audit subprocess time is recorded at coordinator phase level, not job wall time.
The compute train_time_s and allocator peaks in each summary describe its last attempt; cumulative job wall includes prior attempts.
Wall time is not a hardware-independent compute measure. Worker count and physical GPU mapping are recorded in the frozen coordinator contract.
Hyperparameter search, feature extraction, initialization, controller-state maintenance and engineering complexity remain explicit costs.

retained_binary_evidence: Kept at the campaign root; original DONE and asset/data manifests retain their authoritative hashes.
